text_block_list.text:
There's a voice coming from my office. I
crack
open the door and take a peek to
find...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ngh... Why can't I move?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Come on, El! Don't make me count to
three!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You can't lose, El! You gotta do a bunch
of
trainin' today too!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
She's hyping herself up, but she looks
like she's
about to collapse...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It looks like I need to reconsider her
race
schedule before she burns out...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
